Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1335
Claimant:
Christina Ellis
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
06/11/2024
Claim reported by the insured's policyholder following a sideswipe that occurred while changing lanes on a multi-lane
road. The claimant reports a wrist fracture and is represented by counsel, who has requested all future contact be
routed through their office.
07/03/2024
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at the
time of loss. No concerns were identified regarding the policy status.
09/08/2024
Obtained statements from two independent witnesses and the other driver, all of whom confirm the collision
happened as the claimant described. Scene photographs were also received and are consistent with the account
given.
09/18/2024
Inspected the insured vehicle. The damage to the driver side panels matches the described impact pattern. A few
older scratches are visible in the same area and may predate this loss; these have been noted separately for the file.
10/05/2024
Spoke with the claimant's counsel, who provided the medical records for the wrist fracture. The injury is plausible for a
collision of this type, and the claimant has given the same account of events in every conversation so far.
10/07/2024
Medical file shows treatment followed a usual course, with care tapering off as the claimant improved. No prior injury
to the same body area is known from the records received to date.
11/09/2024
Reviewed the claimant's seating position with the available information. It is not fully clear where in the vehicle the
claimant was sitting at the moment of impact, and this will be clarified in a follow-up interview.
11/15/2024
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle damage occurerd before the coverage start date. Requested the prior repair
history to close out the question of the older scratches.
01/12/2025
File reviewed and remains open pending the follow-up interview on seating position and receipt of the prior repair
history. Injury and liability information to date are consistent with the reported facts.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
